heroHeadline: Gang Retaliation Attack Kills at Least 11 After Security Operation as GSF Mandate Vote Looms
heroSubtitle: A gang retaliation attack killed at least 11 people on September 29, 2026 following a Haitian government security operation, underscoring the persistent cycle of gang reprisals. This comes ahead of a UN Security Council vote expected before the Gang Suppression Force's September 30 mandate expiration, with just 1,083 of the 5,500-person authorized ceiling deployed. On September 24, Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé addressed a special UN meeting on Haiti's security and elections, saying "there is a people who can wait no longer" and confirming general elections remain on track for December 13, 2026. The GSF has formally requested a two-year extension through September 2028, as 6.4 million Haitians need humanitarian assistance and nearly 1.5 million remain displaced.
